5646562.sourceDescription: Bring the magic of a frosty winter wonderland into your home with this beautifully full Habitat Christmas tree. Standing tall and ready to become the heart of your festive celebrations, it's been delicately frosted to capture that soft, snowy look that makes Christmas feel truly special. The hinged branches make setup a breeze, and with 605 tips in a mix of 3D and flat needles, you're getting a realistic, full-bodied shape that's ready for all your favourite baubles, lights and finishing touches. Minimal assembly means you'll have it up and looking spectacular in no time, leaving more time for the fun part - decorating. Made from metal and plastic for indoor use, it's designed to be the centrepiece of your Christmas year after year. . Looking after your tree is a piece of cake, so it stays a treasured part of your holiday celebrations for years to come.
